file_purpose: Scheduling/composition layer. References content_id from curated_quran_daily.json / curated_hadith_daily.json only — never duplicates canonical text.

frequency_options.description: User selects exactly one of these 5 predefined daily frequencies in-app. No arbitrary values exposed to the user.

composition_strategy.description: Configurable ratio of Quran vs Hadith items per frequency tier. Not hard-coded as a single fixed rule — the app can override this table.

1.note: single item alternates day-to-day between Quran and Hadith at the delivery layer, not fixed here

composition_strategy.override_note: App-side config can replace default_ratios without touching canonical or curated data.

scheduling_metadata_fields.description: Per-content editorial/product metadata for future scheduling logic. Populated with defaults here; app-side scheduler can refine.
scheduling_metadata_fields.note: These are editorial/product metadata only, never religious-authority claims.

content_pool.quran: See curated_quran_daily.json for the full pool of content_ids eligible for daily delivery.
content_pool.hadith: See curated_hadith_daily.json for the full pool of content_ids eligible for daily delivery.
